Does the GST/HST rate change my monthly budget depending on the province?

Yes. The federal GST is 5% everywhere, but provinces that have harmonized it into a single HST charge more at checkout: Ontario and the Atlantic provinces charge 13–15% combined. Alberta, Yukon, the Northwest Territories, and Nunavut apply only the 5% federal GST with no provincial sales tax on top. Quebec and British Columbia charge GST plus a separate provincial sales tax (9.975% and 7% respectively). Factor this into your monthly grocery, retail, and services budget — it can shift your effective cost of living by several percentage points depending on where you settle.
